answer_1.quote: Dialogue summarization aims to generate a succinct summary while retaining essential information of the dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE and BERTScore for evaluating our models.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation of the dialogue summary to assess its informativeness, conciseness and coverage.
answer_4.guideline: Informativeness measures how well the summary includes key information. Conciseness measures how the summary discards the redundant information. Coverage measures how well the summary covers each part of the dialogue.
